purpose: Form DIR-3B relates to the allotment of a Director Identification Number (DIN) following the submission of Form DIR-3 on the portal and payment of fees.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within a period of one month from the receipt of such application for Central Government communication, and within fifteen days of placing on the website and email for defect rectification.
steps: Submit Form DIR-3 on the portal.
Pay the requisite amount of fees through online mode.

The system automatically generates an application number, provided that if the applicant is a national of a country which shares a land border with India, necessary security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs must be attached first.
The Central Government processes the application and decides on approval or rejection.
If the application is found defective or incomplete, rectify the defects by resubmitting the application within fifteen days of intimation.
checklist: Verify if Form DIR-3 is ready for submission on the portal.
Ensure online fee payment method is ready.
Check if the applicant is a national of a country sharing a land border with India, and if so, ensure security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs is attached.
attachments: Security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (mandatory if the applicant is a national of a country which shares land border with India)
watch: If defects are not removed within the given time, the application will be treated and labeled as invalid, and the fee paid will neither be refunded nor adjusted.
